verdict.rationale: cfo.ai records every change to the Model, including changes made by Ari or MCP-connected agents, in a changelog under the user's name. Every write can be undone, and agent tools run under an allow/ask/deny policy with human approval, so users can review and roll back what automated actions did. However, nothing shows versioning, review, or rollback of the automation definitions themselves: proactive alerts, triggers, sync schedules, or connection configurations. Missing for 10: versioned history of trigger/alert/sync definitions, diff/review of automation configuration changes, rollback of automation definitions to a prior version, independent or hands-on corroboration.
